entries.text: Allah's Name to commence with, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful.
By the oath of those (angels) who harshly extract the soul (of the disbelievers).
And (by those) who untie knots (i.e. remove the souls of believers) gently.
And (by those) who float (in the heavens and the earth) with ease.
Then (by those) who race forward reaching quickly (as though they are in a contest).
Then (by those) who plan the operation (in the system of this universe), that the disbelievers will definitely be punished
On the Day when the trembling one (i.e. the first blast of the Trumpet) will cause trembling.
Thereafter will follow the subsequent one (i.e. the second blast of the Trumpet).
How many hearts will be trembling on that Day (with fear and anxiety).
(They) will be unable to lift up their gaze (due to the horror).
The disbelievers say (mockingly), 'Will we backtrack (i.e. really return to our former state)?'
'What! Even when we have become disintegrated bones?'
They said, 'This return (i.e. resurrection) would in that case be an utter loss.'
So, that is not but a single (terrifying) shout.
Thereupon they will be assembled in an open field (when resurrected).
Did the news of Moosa reach you?
When his Lord called him in the sacred valley of Tuwa.
That 'Go to Fir'awn, he has rebelled.'
'Tell him, “Do you have any inclination towards this that you become pure (from disbelief)?”'
'“And that I may guide you to your Lord, that you may fear.”'
Then Moosa showed him a very big sign (i.e. his luminous hand and staff).
Upon this, he belied it and disobeyed.
He then turned away, (and) started his struggle (against Moosa).
So, he gathered the people, then (he) proclaimed.
And then (he) said, 'I am your highest lord.'
Allah consequently seized him, in the punishment of both this world and the Hereafter.
Indeed, in it is a lesson for those who fear.
According to your understanding, is it (more) difficult to create you or the sky? Allah created it.
He (Allah) elevated its rooftop, then perfected it.
And He darkened its night, and illuminated its brightness (by making the day bright).
And thereafter (He) spread out the earth.
And therefrom (He) produced its water and pasture.
And (He) fixed firmly the mountains.
For your benefit and for the benefit of your cattle.
Then when that common disaster will arrive; (being) the greatest (i.e. the second blow of the Trumpet).
On that Day, man will recall (all) what he struggled for.
And Hell will be made visible to all those who can see.
So, the one who rebelled.
And gave preference to the worldly life.
So indeed, only Hell is his abode.
And as for the one who feared standing in the Majestic Court of his Lord and restricted his soul from (illicit) desire.
So indeed, only Paradise is (his) abode.
They (i.e. the disbelievers) ask you (O Beloved) regarding the Last Day, 'When will its appointed time be?'
What is your concern regarding its explanation?
Only towards your Lord is its finality.
You are purely a warner, for the one who fears it.
The Day when they will see it, it will seem as if they had not remained in this world except for an evening or its morning.
